newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm amid US rate rise speculation.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm amid US rate rise speculation.

text.p: MinFin bonds firmed in calm range trading on Wednesday as the market awaited a possible change in U.S. interest rates, dealers said. Data on U.S. CPI in February pushed prices slightly down.
The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets on March 25 to deliberate interest rates, and all emerging debt markets are uneasy on fears of U.S. interest rate hike later this month.
"Nothing special happened today as the market was waiting for U.S. statistics data in range trading," one dealer said.
Dealers said the bigger than expected 0.3 percent rise in the CPI in February was negative for Bradies and selling was a touch more active.
"Selling has become more active since the data came out (at 1330 GMT)... The market was otherwise firm as there is less client selling seen from London," Sberbank dealer Pavel Sool said.
